topic: Ice and rain protection systems, methods of protection, pneumatic de-icing system, electrical de-icing and anti-icing system
syllabus_extract: Ice and rain protection systems, methods of protection, pneumatic de-icing system, electrical de-icing and anti-icing system.
specific_objectives: 13.1.3.1 Knowledge on circuit protection devices, generators, actuators & engine starting system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB schematics for pneumatic and electrical de-icing loops; verify circuit breaker locations and actuator power sources; instructor supervises schematic tracing and component identification.
intro_questions: What are the primary hazards of ice accumulation on aircraft surfaces?
How does a pneumatic de-icing system utilize engine bleed air?
What is the fundamental difference between de-icing and anti-icing methods?

topics: Ice formation types and critical surfaces
Engine bleed air supply and distribution
development.content:
Ice formation types and critical surfaces
Methods of protection overview
Pneumatic de-icing system operation
Engine bleed air supply and distribution

Electrical de-icing system components
Heating element types and placement
Circuit protection devices and generators
Actuator operation in electrical systems

Anti-icing system integration
System control logic and sequencing
Maintenance checks for de-icing systems
Troubleshooting common electrical faults

summary_questions: Explain the role of circuit protection devices in the electrical de-icing loop.
Describe how the engine starting system relates to pneumatic de-icing availability.
Differentiate between the operational requirements of de-icing versus anti-icing systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the advantages and limitations of pneumatic versus electrical de-icing systems for future application in LP 21 regarding engine air intake protection.

pft_rows.syllabus: Engine air intake and propeller systems, windshield anti-icing systems, ice detection.
